messages:
dylan: Getting a customer escalation — sporadic 502s from hosted API eu-west for streaming generation requests, started ~20m ago. They see ~15% of streams fail with upstream resets. SAMPLE: curl reproducer attached. Can someone triage?
linh: Which pool / region? any tenant id, or prod vs dedicated?
dylan: Hosted prod eu-west, tenant t-56321. Happening across multiple frontdoor nodes, not single host.
jessica: Logs show ENVOY_STREAM_RESET and ECONNRESET on upstream side. No obvious deploys in last hour.
mike: Can you paste the curl they used? also want a quick grep of ingress logs for RST patterns.
dylan: pasted from customer: ```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":1024}' & done; wait
```
linh: OK concurrent short streams. Any big headers or extra metadata? customer uses large billing metadata header via X-Tenant-Meta (~8kb).
jessica: That header size seems large but under typical limit. I pulled envoy access logs for t-56321: lots of 200 for header-only requests, but ~12% upstream reset on streaming endpoints. Pattern: resets happen ~10-30s after stream start.
sre-bot: alert: edge-node-12 memory pressure +2% in last 30m; node rotated TLS session tickets at 1768254200.
mike: TLS ticket rotation could interrupt reused session and cause short reset if client reuses multiplexed connection. Are these HTTP/2 multiplexed?
dylan: Customer client is using HTTP/2 with connection reuse.
linh: Hypothesis: TLS ticket rotation + large metadata header + long-lived streaming = midstream TLS renegotiate or close leading to upstream reset. But envoy should handle. Need repro.
jessica: I can repro locally by mimicking header size and running 100 concurrent streams with keep-alive reuse. Getting RST on ~10% with small client (okhttp) when we trigger session-ticket rotation on LB.
mike: Steps to reproduce (we should run on staging): 1) open 50 h2 streams over 8 connections reusing connections 2) after 60s trigger session-ticket rotate on frontdoor (we can simulate by restarting envoy worker) 3) watch for RST 4) inspect tcpdump on upstream.
dylan: Customer reported they had a frontdoor maintenance earlier where a soft restart of envoy workers was rolled. Could match timeline.
linh: While repro-ing I captured envoy debug: ```[debug][http2] stream reset: remote reset after TLS session update, stream->reset_reason=RST_STREAM(8)``` Not exact log but similar.
jessica: Workaround for customer: advise to disable connection reuse for streaming requests (HTTP/1.1 short-lived) or smaller header footprint; both reduce blast radius.
mike: Longer-term fix: ensure session ticket rotation is worker-friendly (drain connections rather than force close), or tolerate midstream TLS session updates without sending RST_STREAM. I'll open eng-runtime ticket.
sre-bot: created incident INC-2026-1782 (engineers notified).
dylan: For immediate mitigation I propose: 1) route streaming traffic for the customer to the older frontdoor pool without live ticket rotation 2) request customer to set header compression or remove X-Tenant-Meta. Thoughts?
linh: Yes route to pool A; I'll make a temporary routing override for t-56321 to frontdoor-pool-stable.
jessica: I'll send the customer an email template: short repro + mitigation steps and ask for confirmation if disabling connection reuse reduces failures.
mike: Also adding a server-side retry for streaming init failures (non-idempotent caveat) — need product ok. I'll make a small change to retry only on pre-stream init 502s.
dylan: Can someone paste the minimal trace id from one failed request? need to correlate with upsteam logs.
jessica: TraceID: 01-9f7c2b-4a5f3c2d; envoy shows upstream idletimeout=30s then RST. Pasting truncated tcpdump snippet: ```10:25:14.123 IP ... TLS Application Data 
10:25:44.129 IP ... FIN, ACK from upstream 10.0.2.6```
linh: I'll set override now and monitor for 15m, will post metrics.
dylan: Thanks. Anyone need to run customer repro script while I apply routing?
jessica: Do it, I'll watch logs.
sre-bot: routing override applied: t-56321 -> frontdoor-pool-stable, applied at 1768254480 by linh.
jessica: immediate drop in RSTs to ~1.2% from 12% in first 3 minutes.
mike: Good. Opening follow-up eng ticket: ER-859 (frontdoor TLS ticket rotation safe-drain). Assigning to eng-runtime.
linh: Leaving notes: keepalive window mismatch with ticket rotation seems root cause. Will coordinate with infra to change rotation procedure to drain active connections.
dylan: Customer notified of temporary routing and suggested client workaround. Closing this thread once eng confirms a permanent fix plan. :thumbsup:
